bouquet.summary: UltraTech combines industry‑leading profitability and a rock‑solid balance sheet with an ultra‑cheap valuation, making it the best quality‑value play among today’s movers.
bouquet.whyToday: The combination of a large metro‑rail contract win and the imminent infrastructure spending boost creates a near‑term earnings catalyst that lifts UltraTech’s upside potential today.

positives: ROE ~15% and ROCE ~18% – among the highest in the sector
Very low net debt to equity (~0.15x)
Consistently stable earnings over the last 5 years
Strong operating margins (~20% EBIT margin)
Robust cash conversion and dividend track record
Trailing PE ~7.2x – deep discount to sector average
PB ~1.2x – reflects strong asset base
PEG ~0.5x indicating earnings growth outpacing price
Dividend yield ~1.2% with a history of payout increases
negatives: Valuation still modestly premium to pure‑play peers due to recent earnings beat
